basic_profile.bio: I'm a sophomore at Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, currently navigating the complexities of remote learning decisions. Originally from a small town in New York, I have a keen interest in technology and gaming, especially Fortnite and Knockout City. I'm also an avid reader and love tracking my reading progress on BookTrack. I usually browse Reddit late at night, after my part-time shifts at a local bookstore. Currently single, I balance my time between studies, work, and my gaming sessions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in computer science and technology, which I am expanding through my studies at RPI. My knowledge is a mix of formal education and practical experience, particularly in gaming and online communities. I've also self-taught a lot about financial literacy due to my background.
